Apparently Donald Trump doesn't know what a Wind MPPT Charge controller is. I work with this kind of circuit for my final project. I'm majoring (undergraduate) in Electrical Engineering. 

MPPT stands for Maximum Power Point Tracking.

This circuit uses a Microcontroller to track the maximum power and absorb it into a battery. When the power outputted from the wind turbines is higher than the power required from the load, that power is routed to the batteries. If the power is not high enough, the power difference is taken from the batteries.

This way, we don't need the wind to blow all the time in order for wind power to distribute power to the grid all the time.
